When zinc reacts with dilute sulfuric acid, hydrogen gas is produced.
Which apparatus is needed to investigate the effect of temperature on the rate of this reaction?
1
thermometer
2
stop-watch
3
volumetric pipette
4
gas syringe
A
1 and 2
B
1and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3and4
